name: 05-full-cap-technical
description: The 15-finding cap the SQL enforces, technical audience. Most ids to keep straight, so most opportunity to transpose one into an id that was never issued.

findings.title: HTTP does not redirect to HTTPS
findings.plain_english: Visitors who type the address without https can be intercepted. Force the secure version.
findings.remediation: Configure a permanent (301/308) redirect from http:// to https:// at the CDN or web server.

findings.title: Form submits to an insecure or external endpoint
findings.plain_english: Information typed into a form may travel unencrypted or to a vendor visitors do not know about.
findings.remediation: Post forms over HTTPS and document any third-party form processor in the privacy policy.

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security header
findings.plain_english: Browsers are not told to always use the secure connection. One header fixes it.
findings.remediation: Add Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains after confirming every subdomain serves HTTPS.

findings.title: No privacy policy link found
findings.plain_english: Visitors cannot find how their data is used. Most privacy laws require this link.
findings.remediation: Add a visible footer link to a current privacy policy on every page.

findings.title: Third-party trackers loaded before consent could be verified
findings.plain_english: The site uses tracking tools. Depending on where visitors live, consent may be required first.
findings.remediation: Confirm a consent mechanism gates these scripts where required, and list them in the privacy policy.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
findings.plain_english: There is no policy limiting which scripts can run on the page. This is the main defense against injected code.
findings.remediation: Publish a CSP. Start in report-only mode, then enforce script-src and object-src restrictions.

findings.title: Clickjacking protection missing
findings.plain_english: Another site could load your pages inside a hidden frame to trick visitors into clicking.
findings.remediation: Add Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN.

findings.title: Weak HSTS max-age
findings.plain_english: The secure-connection instruction expires too quickly.
findings.remediation: Raise max-age to at least 15552000 seconds (180 days), ideally 31536000.

findings.title: Slow first response
findings.plain_english: The site is slow to start loading. Slow sites lose visitors and rank lower in search.
findings.remediation: Enable caching or a CDN, reduce server-side work on the homepage, and check hosting capacity.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
findings.plain_english: Full page addresses may leak to other sites when visitors click outbound links.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy
findings.plain_english: Browser features like camera and location are not explicitly restricted.
findings.remediation: Add Permissions-Policy disabling camera, microphone, geolocation, and payment unless used.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
findings.plain_english: Browsers may guess file types, which can turn harmless files into executable code.

findings.title: Images missing alternative text
findings.plain_english: People using screen readers cannot tell what these images show.
findings.remediation: Add alt text describing each meaningful image. Use alt="" for purely decorative images.

findings.title: Form fields without an accessible label
findings.plain_english: Screen reader users cannot tell what to type into these fields.
findings.remediation: Pair each field with a label element (for/id) or add aria-label.

findings.title: robots.txt missing
findings.plain_english: Search engines and AI crawlers have no instructions for this site.
findings.remediation: Publish a robots.txt that allows desired crawlers and points to the sitemap.
